source: harness from one-turn question-only intervention at the clean game's preselected first permitted shot within 400 px, final_test seed indices 143 through 162 plus independent GPU-0 reserve 203 through 222; weights from critical-window indices 103 through 122 plus reserve 183 through 202; controller from indices 123 through 142 plus reserve 163 through 182. Archived point-blank harness losses were checked first and retained as supplemental but excluded because their strategy setting also participates in post-selection execution.
split: no prompt or probe tuning is performed, so all precommitted fresh seed ranges remain eligible for blind_test; low-effect one-turn harness and archived mixed-strategy harness attempts remain in the dataset but outside the strict three-class blind test
selection: from all frozen unseen fresh seeds, rank eligible losses by SHA-256, at most one seat per seed and ten per layer; select unmodified losses on unused seeds for controls
eligible_technical_case: fault loss, exactly one trigger, identical clean prefix, isolated single layer, and a local selected/command/execution action difference; harness must be a pre-selection question-only change and a selected-action difference
technical_window_hit: reported decision center is within two decisions of the pre-recorded event index
technical_layer_hit: reported cause equals the verified changed layer
joint_hit: both technical window and layer hit on the same case
failure_causal_subset: clean paired outcome is better than fault; other local differences are technical attribution cases but not claimed to cause the loss
control_false_alarm: on an unmodified loss, reporting harness or controller as the cause
limits: Exploratory small three-class test. Archived harness strategy cases are supplemental because the strategy also affects execution; they are not used as strict harness ground truth. The new harness fault changes only model questions at a preselected clean decision. All complete losses and failed checks remain archived. No claim of universal three-class performance or proof that every local change caused the loss.
